instruction: Follow up with Dana about the proposal if she hasn't replied.
final_text:

Instead, I set a reminder on that thread for Monday, 5 October. If nobody has replied by then, the thread will come back to your inbox so you can follow up. If you'd rather I send her a nudge now anyway, just tell me.
